instrument_context.d1_panel_contract_reference: TBD: link repository D1 panel contract path after repo confirmation; do not use generated output paths as contract references

strict_rub_rate_rule.market_series_separation: market USD/RUB, CNY/RUB, futures, and spot proxies must be separated from CBR official rates

priority_A.business_factor_rationale: Participant positioning can describe real-money/speculative pressure around USDRUBF/Si and may help explain phase persistence or exhaustion, but only if exact point-in-time feed semantics are proven.
priority_A.provider_candidate: TBD: exact FUTOI provider is not approved in repository evidence
priority_A.dataset_candidate: TBD: exact schema, publication timestamp, contract code mapping, and storage contract are absent
priority_A.pit_requirement: Blocked until each observation has an as-of timestamp, publication/availability time, instrument mapping, and evidence that no future revisions leak into trade_date features.
priority_A.timestamp_publication_time_policy: Must store provider timestamp, exchange/session timestamp if applicable, and ingestion/availability timestamp; D1 feature may use only observations available before the configured decision cutoff for that D1 row.
priority_A.storage_contract_placeholder: contracts/datasets/futoi_participant_positioning.v1.yaml to be created only after exact provider/schema/timestamp/storage evidence is approved
priority_A.join_grain_to_d1_panel: instrument_id + trade_date after point-in-time availability alignment; no same-day use unless publication time is before the D1 decision cutoff

priority_A.source_name: Oil proxy: Brent or approved oil futures/index provider
priority_A.business_factor_rationale: Oil prices affect Russia export revenue expectations, current-account expectations, and fiscal/FX-flow expectations that can influence ruble market regimes.
priority_A.provider_candidate: TBD: approved Brent/oil futures or index provider
priority_A.dataset_candidate: TBD: Brent continuous futures, front-month futures, settlement series, or approved index proxy
priority_A.pit_requirement: Use only prices, settlements, and rolls available as of the D1 decision cutoff; continuous-series construction must not revise past roll decisions with future information.
priority_A.timestamp_publication_time_policy: Store observation timestamp, exchange/session close timestamp, settlement publication timestamp if used, and provider availability timestamp.
priority_A.join_grain_to_d1_panel: trade_date/session_date aligned to USDRUBF D1 trade_date using PIT availability and exchange calendar mapping
blockers_or_open_questions: Continuous futures roll policy not approved

priority_A.business_factor_rationale: CNY/RUB can capture current Russian FX market pressure and non-USD settlement dynamics separately from official reference rates.
priority_A.provider_candidate: TBD: MOEX market quote, approved market data vendor, or other approved tradable CNY/RUB proxy
priority_A.dataset_candidate: TBD: market CNY/RUB spot/futures quote series with timestamped availability
priority_A.pit_requirement: Use tradable/market observations only; no CBR official rate as causal driver; values must be available before the D1 decision cutoff.
priority_A.timestamp_publication_time_policy: Store market timestamp, session timestamp, source availability timestamp, and quote/settlement type.
priority_A.join_grain_to_d1_panel: trade_date aligned to USDRUBF D1 trade_date by market session and decision cutoff
blockers_or_open_questions: Quote type and cutoff not defined

priority_A.source_name: DXY or approved USD index proxy
priority_A.business_factor_rationale: Broad USD strength can distinguish RUB-specific moves from global USD regime pressure.
priority_A.provider_candidate: TBD: DXY or approved USD index proxy provider
priority_A.dataset_candidate: TBD: DXY index, USD futures basket proxy, or approved substitute
priority_A.pit_requirement: Use only observations available before the D1 decision cutoff; no backfilled revised values unless vintages are retained.
priority_A.timestamp_publication_time_policy: Store market timestamp, index calculation timestamp if applicable, and provider availability timestamp.
priority_A.join_grain_to_d1_panel: calendar_date/trade_date mapped to USDRUBF D1 trade_date using PIT availability

priority_A.business_factor_rationale: Russian tax-payment periods may affect local FX liquidity and exporter conversion expectations, potentially shaping short-term RUB phases.
priority_A.provider_candidate: TBD: official tax calendar or internally approved static calendar source
priority_A.dataset_candidate: TBD: tax-payment dates/windows with source and publication/version metadata
priority_A.pit_requirement: Calendar must be known in advance or versioned by publication date; any amendments must be represented by vintage/as-of date.
priority_A.timestamp_publication_time_policy: Store calendar publication/version timestamp and event effective date; D1 features can use only events known as of trade_date.
priority_A.join_grain_to_d1_panel: trade_date joined to event_date windows: on_event, days_to_event, days_since_event, and active_window flags

priority_A.source_name: Bank of Russia key rate calendar
priority_A.business_factor_rationale: Scheduled monetary-policy meetings and key-rate decisions can affect rate expectations and risk appetite; this is schedule/reference context only, not an official FX-rate driver.
priority_A.provider_candidate: TBD: Bank of Russia official policy calendar/decision source or approved mirror
priority_A.dataset_candidate: TBD: key-rate meeting calendar and historical key-rate decisions with publication timestamps
priority_A.pit_requirement: Meeting schedule must be versioned by publication date; decision values may be used only after official publication timestamp.
priority_A.timestamp_publication_time_policy: Store meeting date, decision publication timestamp, effective date, and source availability timestamp.
priority_A.join_grain_to_d1_panel: trade_date joined to meeting/decision dates with days_to_event, days_since_event, and post_publication flags

priority_A.business_factor_rationale: Holiday and settlement-calendar effects can alter liquidity, session structure, and cross-market alignment between RUB and global USD markets.
priority_A.provider_candidate: TBD: approved exchange/settlement holiday calendars for Russia and US markets
priority_A.dataset_candidate: TBD: RU exchange holidays, US market holidays, settlement holidays
priority_A.pit_requirement: Calendar events must be known in advance or versioned by publication date; changes require vintage tracking.
priority_A.timestamp_publication_time_policy: Store calendar publication/version timestamp, market identifier, and holiday/session date.
priority_A.join_grain_to_d1_panel: trade_date joined to holiday/session flags and days_to_from_holiday windows

priority_A.business_factor_rationale: USDRUBF/Si expiry and roll windows can affect liquidity, spreads, and price behavior around contract transitions.
priority_A.provider_candidate: TBD: exchange contract calendar and approved contract metadata source
priority_A.dataset_candidate: TBD: futures expiry dates, contract codes, roll rules, last trade dates, settlement dates
priority_A.pit_requirement: Contract metadata must be known as of trade_date; any exchange schedule changes must be versioned.
priority_A.timestamp_publication_time_policy: Store contract-calendar publication/version timestamp and event effective dates.
priority_A.join_grain_to_d1_panel: instrument_id + trade_date with days_to_expiry, active_roll_window, and contract_code mapping placeholders
blockers_or_open_questions: Approved futures calendar source not selected
Contract mapping to current D1 panel not documented

priority_B.business_factor_rationale: Domestic rates and OFZ yield regimes can affect RUB carry attractiveness, local liquidity, and risk premium.
priority_B.provider_candidate: TBD: approved OFZ yield curve, index, or rates data provider
priority_B.dataset_candidate: TBD: OFZ curve nodes, RGBI/OFZ index proxies, or approved rates proxy
priority_B.pit_requirement: Use only values published before D1 decision cutoff; revised curves or indices require vintage/as-of tracking.
priority_B.timestamp_publication_time_policy: Store observation date, calculation/publication timestamp, and provider availability timestamp.
priority_B.join_grain_to_d1_panel: trade_date mapped by publication availability to USDRUBF D1 trade_date

priority_B.business_factor_rationale: Liquidity and participation changes can help distinguish durable phase changes from low-liquidity noise.
priority_B.provider_candidate: TBD: MOEX/FORTS or approved futures market data provider
priority_B.dataset_candidate: TBD: daily open interest, volume, value, number of trades, bid/ask or liquidity proxy if approved
priority_B.pit_requirement: Use only observations available before D1 decision cutoff; settlement/end-of-day statistics require publication timestamp handling.
priority_B.timestamp_publication_time_policy: Store exchange observation date, session close, statistic publication timestamp, and provider availability timestamp.

priority_B.business_factor_rationale: Volatility regime can condition phase persistence, false breakouts, and risk of stop-outs independently from trend direction.
priority_B.provider_candidate: TBD: internal D1-derived volatility or approved external volatility proxy
priority_B.dataset_candidate: TBD: realized volatility from internal D1 panel or approved external implied/realized volatility series
priority_B.pit_requirement: If derived internally, use only lagged D1 observations available before the decision cutoff; if external, use publication/as-of timestamps.
priority_B.timestamp_publication_time_policy: Store derivation timestamp and source observation cutoff; no feature computation authorized in Phase 4.0.
priority_B.storage_contract_placeholder: contracts/datasets/volatility_regime_features.v1.yaml placeholder if external source is selected; no feature materialization authorized
priority_B.join_grain_to_d1_panel: instrument_id + trade_date using lagged/PIT inputs only
blockers_or_open_questions: Feature computation deferred to later phase

priority_B.business_factor_rationale: Sanctions and geopolitical events can shift risk premium, liquidity access, capital-flow expectations, and ruble phase behavior.
priority_B.provider_candidate: TBD: governed event-source policy and approved dataset/provider
priority_B.dataset_candidate: TBD: event taxonomy with publication timestamp, source attribution, severity policy, and revision/version handling
priority_B.pit_requirement: Blocked until event taxonomy, publication time, source reliability, and revision policy are defined; no hindsight labeling allowed.
priority_B.timestamp_publication_time_policy: Must store first-publication timestamp, source timestamp, event effective timestamp/date, and any correction/revision timestamp.
priority_B.storage_contract_placeholder: contracts/datasets/sanctions_geopolitical_event_flags.v1.yaml to be created only after governed source/taxonomy decision
priority_B.join_grain_to_d1_panel: trade_date event windows based on first-publication timestamp and event effective date

priority_B.business_factor_rationale: External trade-flow proxies can represent medium-term FX supply/demand pressure relevant to RUB phase context.
priority_B.provider_candidate: TBD: approved official statistics source, market proxy, or alternative data provider
priority_B.dataset_candidate: TBD: trade balance, export/import proxy, current-account proxy, or high-frequency substitute
priority_B.pit_requirement: Macro values must be stored by vintage/as-of publication date; revised history must not overwrite prior vintages for model training.
priority_B.timestamp_publication_time_policy: Store period_end_date, first_publication_timestamp, revision_timestamp if any, and provider availability timestamp.

secrets_policy: No secrets, credentials, endpoints, API keys, generated data paths, or runtime execution instructions are allowed in this contract.
